draft.shortGloss: to come; to arrive; to seem
draft.emotion: welcoming and expectant, calling someone closer
notes: Takes the dative case (-e/-a) for the destination (eve gelmek = to come home) and ablative (-den/-dan) for the origin.
The present/aorist tense takes the irregular vowel -i-: gelir (he/she comes).
